actual_scope: For a five-child dirty echo with three workspace pentads and one output pentad, replace the previous order-four frame with explicit order-five cyclic permutations; derive and verify the exact five-state frame schedule and its fully charged echo cost against eager restoration, then compare two consecutive five-child echoes with one ten-child echo.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a pair of consecutive calls. This construction changes the boundary group from C4 to C5 and uses the earlier order-four package only as a predecessor, avoiding the active C4 heterogeneous 3+7 and selected T16 helper-reuse scopes. It verifies actual removed frame work in the new C5 reader family and includes a separate paired-call composition; it is not a recurrence-only rewrite or a rerun of the C4 search.
bottleneck_link: A paid child rotates a dirty workspace frame. Carrying its C5 phase through five children eliminates repeated workspace restoration; pairing two echoes also removes one paid outer source-copy/restore wrapper. This is an abstract recursive-interface construction, not an admitted selected-supplier profile.
stop_rule: Exhaust the five-state phase paths for k=5 and use the exact recurrence for k=10; verify the five- and ten-child maps, complete invoices and failure controls. Stop after this C5 selector family; no search over other groups, child counts or suppliers.
